name: A Walk Through Kramfors
summary:
Wake up inside your own forgotten life in A Walk Through Kramfors, an eerie point-and-click adventure set in a decaying industrial town in northern Sweden. The streets feel familiar. The rooms feel occupied. But reality keeps shifting, and nothing is quite where you left it.

Wander through Kramfors, pick up what you find along the way, and solve small, unsettling puzzles to piece together what happened. Some chapters break the pace with side-scrolling sequences, and the whole story can be played in about 30 minutes.
